status: DRAFT written by Claude; human review deferred at the owner's instruction
correct_action: park cases: stop (decide now to stop, decline, freeze, retire or not renew; work limited to carrying out the stop, such as notice or migration help). investigate cases: research_first (defer the decision for bounded evidence-gathering).

p1-legacy-integration.why: Four of 3,100 accounts, an API shutdown and ongoing maintenance cost already decide it; interviews can only shape migration help, not the decision.

p2-premium-support.why: A randomised test missed its target tenfold with 40% refunds; a price survey of non-buyers is reported evidence that cannot outweigh observed behaviour.

p3-ios-widget.why: Low use, no retention effect and recurring QA cost; a diary study cannot justify a five-week rewrite. Retire or freeze with notice.

p4-us-expansion.why: Unprofitable home market and nine months of runway; a three-month study spends a third of runway on an option the company cannot fund. Revisit when UK payback meets target.

p5-bank-partnership.why: An unsupported, one-off requirement with no commitment after four months; a six-week feasibility study is sunk cost. Revisit only with a committed contract.

p6-pdf-export.why: 0.4% use, heavy users already have CSV and renewal is due next month; a three-month study outlasts the deadline. Decline renewal and help the six accounts move.

i1-soc2.why: Analysing 140 recorded loss reasons is cheap and fast and decides a £60,000 commitment; neither starting nor dropping is justified yet.

i2-auto-scheduling.why: Two weeks of exposure with five days of broken logging cannot show low adoption; fix tracking and set a decision date.

i3-offline-mode.why: The drop coincides with the settings redesign, suggesting a discoverability regression; check it before removing the feature.
